title: Elkhorn Hollow
description: Elkhorn Hollow is a welcoming survival community designed for players who enjoy cooperative building and a friendly, relaxed atmosphere. Come explore our unique, custom-generated landscapes and find your perfect spot to build a home among friends!
body:
Welcome to Elkhorn Hollow
Elkhorn Hollow is a welcoming, community-driven survival server designed for players who value cooperation, creativity, and a relaxed atmosphere. Whether you are looking to build sprawling architectural masterpieces, explore unique custom-generated landscapes, or simply forge new friendships, our world offers the perfect foundation for your next adventure. Join us today to experience a balanced, player-focused environment where your contributions help shape the future of our growing home!
